skill.summary: Track questions Hans failed to answer and flag missing knowledge

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the knowledge-gaps skill.
- Tracks questions Hans cannot answer and flags missing knowledge.
- Requires Hans to log unanswered questions with a script and confirm success before notifying the user.
- Adds a weekly summary of top knowledge gaps for review and improvement.
- Establishes a feedback loop to progressively reduce unknowns over time.
